A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. The main text, figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–D are readable and matchable; v4's additional end matter does not limit comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original probing benchmark results in Tables 2 and 4–6, plus prototype-count and binarization ablations in Appendix B, Table 7.

after.justification: v4 retains the original benchmark results and Appendix B ablations, including numerical outcomes for the proposed probe and comparison methods.

M1.justification: Section 2.3 retains the same class-agnostic binary prototypes, straight-through gradients, cosine matching, max pooling and linear classifier. The protofloat ablation variant already appears in v3.

E1.justification: Section 4.1 and Table 8 retain five general multi-label datasets, seven BirdSet subsets and two single-label control tasks. The new dataset links do not add evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments in Tables 2–7, including linpre in Table 2, cited fine-tuning comparisons in Table 3 and protofloat in Table 7.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix D retain the same splits, preprocessing, 64-shot protocol, evaluation metrics and hyperparameter search. Training remains 30 epochs with AdamW and batch size 128.

E4.justification: Appendix B retains the prototype-count sensitivity study and comparisons separating binarization from architectural simplification. The visual case study and analyses of polyphony, backbone rankings and supervised adaptation are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report benchmark means and standard deviations over five seeds and Table 7 ablation means over three seeds. Seed-based hyperparameter selection and Figure 5's one-standard-deviation win criterion are unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched numerical entries, rankings and plotted findings are unchanged. For example, EAT with protobin on as20k remains 31.67 mAP in Tables 2 and 4; Table 7's ablation results also match.

T1.justification: Section 2's mathematical definitions and Equations 1–3 are unchanged, as are Appendix C's computational run-count calculations. No formal assumption, derivation or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about the pooling bottleneck, limitations of conventional probing and benefits of binarized prototypical probes. Contribution scope and novelty claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, applicability qualifications and caching tradeoff are retained. Appendix B changes 'holds a slight performance edge' to 'performs slightly better,' preserving the same interpretation of the binarization tradeoff.

D1.justification: The reproducibility statement replaces the anonymous code link with a named GitHub repository and the generic Hugging Face homepage with specific DESED, SPASS and Urban-SED dataset links. This improves access instructions; implementation and resource details in Appendices C–D are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference entries and Section 3 positioning are unchanged, including the relationship to prior prototypical probes and attentive pooling methods.

P1.justification: v4 adds Author Contributions and Acknowledgements, updates the publication header and affiliation/contact information, and makes one wording edit in Appendix B. The scientific narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: The running header and first-page author block change, while added disclosures reflow the end matter and shift appendix pagination. Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–10 retain their content, captions and visual designs.

improvement.justification: v4 makes reproducibility instructions more actionable by replacing a generic dataset-hosting homepage with three specific dataset links and identifying the code repository. Author-role and funding disclosures add transparency. These are limited documentation gains; the scientific evidence and conclusions are unchanged, and external resource availability is not established by the PDFs.
